actions.title: Close the window
actions.instruction: A window is open: close it first, the room will warm up quickly.

actions.title: Raise heating by 1 °C
actions.instruction: Raise the room's thermostat setpoint by 1 °C.

actions.title: Warm drink or sweater
actions.instruction: Have a hot tea and put on a warm sweater or a blanket; the heating stays in night mode.

actions.title: Let the sun warm the room
actions.instruction: Sunshine is expected soon: open the blinds and let the sun warm the room; a sweater helps until then.

actions.title: Lower heating by 1 °C
actions.instruction: Lower the room's thermostat setpoint by 1 °C.

actions.title: Ventilate briefly
actions.instruction: Open the window wide for five minutes, then close it again.

actions.title: Shock ventilation
actions.instruction: Open the windows wide for five to ten minutes; turn the thermostat down meanwhile.
